$comment: Index of every upstream docs source the contract system consults. Adding a new source here makes the bidirectional discovery validator aware of it. See generator/parser/docs.ts. For the openapi source, pinnedSha records the upstream main COMMIT SHA from the pin header (unified on commit SHAs since the 2026-10-22 refresh — previously a blob SHA that silently lagged the pin). Since the 2026-10-23 refresh the mdx sources carry pinnedSha/pinnedAt too: pinnedSha is the last upstream commit touching the repo's docs/api/*.mdx source (the rendered markdown twin is what we pin, but its provenance anchor is that commit), pinnedAt is the refresh date; test/contract/pin-consistency.test.ts asserts both stay in lockstep with each pin's header.

sources.$comment: The rendered native API docs. Currently consulted at runtime by scripts/verify-api-parity.ts (the legacy verifier); the contract system will start consuming this in Wave 2 once an HTML→endpoint extractor exists.
